cited_by.title: CCCA: scarring hair loss at the crown

record.population: 8 African American women with no clinical hair loss who used chemical or heat straighteners
record.finding: Every biopsy showed inflammation around the follicle opening and a ring of fibrosis, with no follicle loss. The authors say these are findings characteristic of CCCA and suggest a histological prelude, and that CCCA may be a common pathway of inflammation and scarring that traumatic hairstyling can set off in genetically predisposed people.
record.note: Eight women, no comparison group: cannot show that styling caused the changes.
